description: The review recommends that dental hygiene programs embed hands-on opportunities to build students' confidence in the weak domains of policy use, research, and advocacy.
title: Integrate experiential learning activities — community outreach projects, collaborative policy simulations, and applied research opportunities — into dental hygiene curricula

description: Based on the finding that interpersonal and digital competencies are closely intertwined in patient-centered DHN support, the authors propose that DHN training should combine both.
title: Develop standardized DHN training curricula that integrate interpersonal soft skills with digital competencies
